name: Body makeup / leg makeup

card.summary: Wash-off colour that evens tone and darkens skin for photos; a cosmetic with no trial evidence behind it.
card.note: Can rub off on clothing and look uneven.

quick.overview:
Body makeup, including leg makeup and bronzers, is a wash-off cosmetic that adds colour or evens skin tone, often for photos or events.

It is discussed as a quick alternative or complement to self-tanner. No clinical studies have examined it.
quick.mechanism: The product deposits a temporary tint on the skin surface and is removed with soap and water.[1]
quick.risks: Reported drawbacks are rub-off onto clothing, uneven or orange-looking results, and possible allergens such as fragrances or benzyl alcohol in some formulations.

lead: Body makeup, often sold as leg makeup, is a cosmetic applied to the skin below the face to even out tone, cover marks and add colour, usually for a photo, stage, event or sun-free tan. Wikipedia describes foundation applied to the body as body makeup, with sheer to full coverage depending on the formula [2]. For appearance, it can make legs and arms look more uniform and tanned, and full-coverage products are used to cover birthmarks, vitiligo, hyperpigmentation and scars [2].

Temporary bronzers belong to the same family. Wikipedia lists them as powders, sprays, mousses, gels and lotions that tint the surface of the skin and wash off with soap and water, mostly for one-day tans or alongside a DHA self-tanner [1]. Some lotions contain a gradual tanning agent so colour builds with repeated use [1].

In looksmaxxing forums, bronzer and contour are discussed mostly for the face, with posters saying they brighten dull skin tone and sharpen features [3][4]. Reported drawbacks are rub-off onto clothes and an orange or blotchy look if applied unevenly [1]. No published trials have tested body makeup for appearance outcomes.

chain: Pigmented product applied over skin surface
Tone looks more even and tanned, marks are covered
Legs and body photograph or present more uniformly
angle.text: Body makeup colours and evens the skin surface right away, covering blemishes, scars or pale patches for the length of an event or photo. It washes off with soap and water.

infobox: Powder, spray, mousse, gel, lotion, cream
Cosmetic; 'bronzer' is not a legally defined category in the US
Even tone, temporary tan, covering marks

paras: Temporary bronzing and tinting products colour only the surface of the skin and do not involve the chemical reaction that DHA self-tanners use [1]. Common ingredients include walnut oil extract, jojoba extract and caramel colour [1]. Foundation formulas include oil-based, alcohol-based, powder, mineral, water-based and silicone-based types, with coverage from sheer to full [2].

Medium coverage can hide freckles, discolouration and pimple marks, while full coverage is used for birthmarks, vitiligo, hyperpigmentation and scars [2]. Bronzers are used for a one-day tan or to complement a self-tan [1]. A poster on looksmax.org argued that bronzer with BB cream brightened dull skin tone and made weak skin quality less noticeable [3], and another thread described bronzer and contouring with fake tan as a way to change the look of the face considerably [4].

Foundation has a long history: Wikipedia traces face paints to ancient Egypt, lead-based whiteners to Greece and Rome, theatrical greasepaint to the 1800s and Max Factor's Pan-Cake, patented in 1937, as the first commercial foundation [2].

Listed drawbacks include limited sweat or water resistance in some formulas, transfer onto clothing and uneven results [1]. Some formulations contain possible allergens such as benzyl alcohol, tocopherol and fragrances [1]. A 2021 study cited by Wikipedia found organic fluorine, an indicator of PFAS, in 63 percent of foundations tested [2]. Wikipedia calls bronzers much safer than tanning beds [1].

timeline.event: Max Factor's Pan-Cake foundation is patented and becomes the first commercially available foundation [2].

lore.intro: Bronzer and fake tan come up on looksmax.org as softmax cosmetic tools for skin tone and facial definition.

claims.claim: Bronzer plus BB cream brightens dull skin tone
claims.believers: One poster said it makes skin look brighter and fresher and hides weak skin quality [3].
claims.experts: No published studies have examined bronzer for skin appearance; reference sources describe it as a wash-off surface tint [1].

claims.claim: Bronzer and contour can change the face a great deal
claims.believers: The original poster called it close to cosmetic surgery without the surgery, noting it needs to be done well [4].
claims.experts: No published studies have tested this. Sources note that misapplied bronzer can look orange and blotchy [1].
